evidence.detail: Partial fix: stopped lowercasing deck names before sanitizing, so AggroSlide is preserved IF the player already typed it correctly. Fixes #12152 but not #12138.
titlecase.titlecase() is still applied after normalize, so 'aggroslide' becomes 'Aggroslide' not 'AggroSlide' — the archetype-aware correction the issue requests is absent
normalize() has access to d.get('archetype_name') but only uses it to decide whether to skip color-adding steps; it does not use it to correct casing of tokens within the name

triage.notes: Full fix would require: (1) a lookup of known archetype names (either from DB at sanitization time or a prebuilt list), (2) a token-matching step that replaces incorrectly-cased tokens with the canonical archetype casing. Lowercased MTGO usernames add further complexity.
